response.justification: Experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial exposure (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS) and some low-latency distributed systems work in D at Sociomantic, but the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development — is essentially absent. C++ appears only in a six-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago and a university thesis project; the last ~8 years are predominantly TypeScript/Node.js product and full-stack work. There is no evidence of routing/navigation data pipelines, map tiling, or large-scale batch geodata processing. The GIS interest and systems curiosity make him a long-shot candidate worth a screening call only if the team can absorb a significant C++ ramp-up.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including an open-source geo-data platform
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices work (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux/Docker/K8s ops
concerns: Minimal and outdated modern C++ experience; no Rust; primary stack is TypeScript/Node
No navigation, routing, or map-tiling pipeline experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack and AI tooling, not systems-level data infrastructure
